### Angewandte Ökonomie

Groups: 6 · Skills: 18

[appliedEconomics.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/appliedEconomics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Specialized markets and institutional conditions in cities, housing, transport, education, healthcare, and agriculture create distinct economic mechanisms. This domain examines sector-specific choices and consequences without duplicating geographic, medical, educational, or agricultural competencies.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, wie ökonomische Prinzipien für Städte, Wohnen, Verkehr, Bildung, Gesundheit und Landwirtschaft gelten.

#### Agrarökonomie

Skills: 3

[agriculturalEconomics.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/agriculturalEconomics/agriculturalEconomics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Biological cycles, uncertain weather, land use, and international exchange shape agricultural markets.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erfahre, warum Landwirtschaft besondere Kosten und Risiken mit sich bringt.

##### Agrarmärkte

[agriculturalMarkets.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/agriculturalEconomics/skills/agriculturalMarkets.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze farm-product prices in light of seasonality, storage opportunities, harvest variations, and international trade.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, warum Lebensmittelpreise je nach Jahreszeit, Ernte und Handel schwanken.

##### Saisonalität und Agrarrisiken

[agriculturalSeasonalityAndRisk.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/agriculturalEconomics/skills/agriculturalSeasonalityAndRisk.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate how seasonal cycles, weather shocks, and variable costs influence production and options for insurance or hedging.

**User-friendly description (de):** Verstehe, wie Landwirte saisonale Unsicherheit und Wetterrisiken bewältigen.

##### Ernährungssicherheit als wirtschaftliches Problem

[foodSecurityAsAnEconomicIssue.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/agriculturalEconomics/skills/foodSecurityAsAnEconomicIssue.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze physical and economic access to food, stability of supplies, and why sufficient aggregate production does not ensure everyone can obtain food.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, warum genügend Nahrungsmittel zu erzeugen nicht bedeutet, dass alle sie sich leisten oder erhalten können.

#### Bildungsökonomie

Skills: 3

[economicsOfEducation.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/economicsOfEducation/economicsOfEducation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Investing in knowledge creates private and social returns and raises questions of financing, access, and uncertain information.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde Nutzen, Kosten und Finanzierung von Bildung.

##### Wirtschaftliche Ungleichheit in der Bildung

[economicInequalityInEducation.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/economicsOfEducation/skills/economicInequalityInEducation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze how household income, local resources, institutions, and information shape learning opportunities and later economic outcomes.

**User-friendly description (de):** Verstehe, warum Familien und Gemeinschaften ungleiche Bildungschancen haben.

##### Wirtschaftlicher Ertrag von Bildung

[economicReturnsToEducation.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/economicsOfEducation/skills/economicReturnsToEducation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess expected changes in earnings, productivity, and opportunity relative to time and schooling costs without automatically interpreting an education–earnings correlation as causal.

**User-friendly description (de):** Vergleiche den wirtschaftlichen Nutzen der Bildung mit dem Aufwand an Zeit und Geld.

##### Bildungsfinanzierung

[educationFinancing.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/economicsOfEducation/skills/educationFinancing.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare private and public financing of education by cost distribution, access, and incentives.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, wer Bildung bezahlt und wie Finanzierungsentscheidungen den Zugang beeinflussen.

#### Gesundheitsökonomie

Skills: 3

[healthEconomics.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/healthEconomics/healthEconomics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Healthcare markets involve substantial information asymmetry, insurance arrangements, and external effects of population health.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erfahre, warum Gesundheitsmärkte anders funktionieren als Märkte für gewöhnliche Produkte.

##### Krankenversicherung und Moral Hazard

[healthInsuranceAndMoralHazard.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/healthEconomics/skills/healthInsuranceAndMoralHazard.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how insurance coverage changes the allocation of costs and incentives to use services without labeling all care-seeking as undesirable behavior.

**User-friendly description (de):** Verstehe, wie Versicherungen beeinflussen, wer bezahlt und wie Leistungen genutzt werden.

##### Finanzierung des Gesundheitswesens

[healthcareFinancing.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/healthEconomics/skills/healthcareFinancing.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare tax-based, insurance-based, and direct payment by access, household financial risk, and system costs.

**User-friendly description (de):** Vergleiche verschiedene Wege zur Finanzierung der Gesundheitsversorgung.

##### Märkte für Gesundheitsleistungen

[healthcareServiceMarkets.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/healthEconomics/skills/healthcareServiceMarkets.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze interactions among patients, clinicians, insurers, and facilities under unequal access to information, prices, and service quality.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, warum beim Kauf von Gesundheitsleistungen komplexe Informationen und Anreize eine Rolle spielen.

#### Wohnen und Immobilien

Skills: 3

[housingAndRealEstate.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/housingAndRealEstate/housingAndRealEstate.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Housing prices and affordability depend on land, construction, income, mortgage finance, local demand, and regulation.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, warum Hauspreise und Mieten von Ort zu Ort unterschiedlich sind.

##### Bezahlbarkeit von Wohnraum

[housingAffordability.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/housingAndRealEstate/skills/housingAffordability.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare purchase or rental expenses with income, debts, quality, and location; distinguish affordability from market price alone.

**User-friendly description (de):** Finde heraus, wann Wohnraum für einen bestimmten Haushalt bezahlbar ist.

##### Wohnungsmarkt

[housingMarket.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/housingAndRealEstate/skills/housingMarket.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze rents and house prices in relation to local demand, available supply, construction lead times, and financing.

**User-friendly description (de):** Verstehe, wie lokales Angebot und Nachfrage die Wohnungspreise beeinflussen.

##### Ökonomie der Flächennutzung

[landUseEconomics.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/housingAndRealEstate/skills/landUseEconomics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate how zoning, development limits, and alternative uses of land affect rents, construction volumes, and the location of activity.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, wie Regeln zur Flächennutzung bestimmen, wo und was Menschen bauen.

#### Verkehr und Infrastruktur

Skills: 3

[transportAndInfrastructure.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/transportAndInfrastructure/transportAndInfrastructure.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Moving people and goods creates direct and external costs, while infrastructure requires large initial investments and lasts for long periods.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde die wirtschaftlichen Zielkonflikte bei Verkehr und öffentlicher Infrastruktur.

##### Ökonomie von Verkehrsstaus

[congestionEconomics.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/transportAndInfrastructure/skills/congestionEconomics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the external costs of adding a user to a congested network and compare pricing or demand-management responses.

**User-friendly description (de):** Verstehe, warum jedes zusätzliche Fahrzeug andere Fahrzeuge ausbremsen kann.

##### Bewertung von Infrastrukturinvestitionen

[infrastructureInvestmentAppraisal.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/transportAndInfrastructure/skills/infrastructureInvestmentAppraisal.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare upfront and long-term project costs with travel-time savings, accessibility, and other social outcomes over a specified horizon.

**User-friendly description (de):** Bewerte, ob der Nutzen eines Verkehrsprojekts seine Gesamtkosten rechtfertigt.

##### Verkehrsnachfrage

[transportDemand.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/transportAndInfrastructure/skills/transportDemand.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze how fare or price, travel time, frequency, reliability, and available alternatives affect choice of travel mode.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, warum Menschen ein Verkehrsmittel statt eines anderen wählen.

#### Stadt- und Regionalökonomie

Skills: 3

[urbanAndRegionalEconomics.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/urbanAndRegionalEconomics/urbanAndRegionalEconomics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Concentrations of people and firms yield benefits from proximity, infrastructure constraints, and regional specialization.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, warum Städte und Regionen unterschiedliche wirtschaftliche Stärken entwickeln.

##### Agglomerationseffekte

[agglomerationEffects.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/urbanAndRegionalEconomics/skills/agglomerationEffects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain benefits and costs of concentrating firms and workers in cities through knowledge exchange, shared resources, congestion, and land prices.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, warum die räumliche Konzentration von Unternehmen die Produktivität, aber auch die Kosten steigern kann.

##### Regionale wirtschaftliche Ungleichheiten

[regionalEconomicDisparities.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/urbanAndRegionalEconomics/skills/regionalEconomicDisparities.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare territories' productivity, incomes, access to jobs, and infrastructure, distinguishing indicator levels from geographical location alone.

**User-friendly description (de):** Vergleiche wirtschaftliche Chancen verschiedener Regionen anhand passender Kennzahlen.

##### Regionale Spezialisierung

[regionalSpecialization.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/urbanAndRegionalEconomics/skills/regionalSpecialization.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze why different territories concentrate particular activities because of resource access, markets, human capital, and institutions.

**User-friendly description (de):** Verstehe, warum verschiedene Regionen sich auf unterschiedliche Branchen spezialisieren.

### Verbraucherverhalten

Groups: 3 · Skills: 13

[consumerBehavior.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/consumerBehavior.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consumers evaluate needs, quality, alternatives, and information under varying incomes and psychological constraints. This domain analyzes their choices rather than sellers' methods of promoting goods.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, wie Menschen entscheiden, was sie kaufen, und welche Informationen ihre Entscheidungen beeinflussen.

#### Verhaltensfaktoren bei Entscheidungen

Skills: 4

[behavioralFactorsInChoice.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/behavioralFactorsInChoice.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Limited attention and rationality, time preferences, presentation formats, and defaults can alter economic choices even when the formal options are unchanged.

**User-friendly description (de):** Entdecke, wie die Darstellung von Auswahlmöglichkeiten Entscheidungen beeinflusst.

##### Begrenzte Rationalität

[boundedRationality.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/skills/boundedRationality.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how limits of time, knowledge, or computational ability lead decision-makers to use simplified rules.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkenne, warum Menschen oft Faustregeln verwenden, statt alle Optionen zu vergleichen.

##### Entscheidungsarchitektur

[choiceArchitecture.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/skills/choiceArchitecture.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how default options, presentation order, and the difficulty of opting out affect choices without changing the underlying alternatives.

**User-friendly description (de):** Achte darauf, wie Standardoptionen und Anordnungen Entscheidungen lenken können.

##### Framing-Effekt

[framingEffect.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/skills/framingEffect.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify how equivalent information framed as gains or losses can change the assessment of a choice.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, warum dieselben Fakten als Gewinne oder Verluste unterschiedlich wirken.

##### Gegenwartspräferenz

[presentBias.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/skills/presentBias.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize systematic overvaluation of immediate benefits relative to delayed consequences.

**User-friendly description (de):** Verstehe, warum sofortige Belohnungen bessere zukünftige Ergebnisse überwiegen können.

#### Verbraucherinformationen und -rechte

Skills: 4

[consumerInformationAndRights.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/consumerInformationAndRights/consumerInformationAndRights.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Sound consumer decisions depend not only on price but also on product information, contract terms, and possible protections.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erfahre, wie Informationen und Verbraucherrechte Kaufentscheidungen beeinflussen.

##### Verbraucherrechte und -pflichten

[consumerRightsAndResponsibilities.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/consumerInformationAndRights/skills/consumerRightsAndResponsibilities.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret warranties, returns, and buyer and seller obligations in the applicable legal context.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkenne Rechte und Pflichten, die mit einem Kauf verbunden sind.

##### Qualität von Verbraucherinformationen

[qualityOfConsumerInformation.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/consumerInformationAndRights/skills/qualityOfConsumerInformation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess the origin, timeliness, and evidence supporting claims about goods and services, including review independence, rating representativeness, and sources' commercial interests.

**User-friendly description (de):** Prüfe, ob Produktversprechen, Bewertungen und Rezensionen verlässlich sind.

##### Gesamtkosten des Kaufs

[totalCostOfPurchase.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/consumerInformationAndRights/skills/totalCostOfPurchase.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Estimate all substantial buyer-side costs, including delivery, operation, maintenance, and fees, when comparing options, even when these costs are disclosed. Seller-imposed optional extras belong to commercial-practices analysis.

**User-friendly description (de):** Vergleiche alle tatsächlichen Kaufkosten, nicht nur den angezeigten Preis.

##### Grundpreis

[unitPricing.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/consumerInformationAndRights/skills/unitPricing.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Convert offer prices into comparable units of mass, volume, or quantity while accounting for bundle contents, quality, and promotional conditions; a cheaper package need not have a cheaper unit price.

**User-friendly description (de):** Vergleiche Produkte fair anhand der Kosten pro Einheit.

#### Bedürfnisse und Präferenzen

Skills: 5

[needsAndPreferences.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/needsAndPreferences.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Personal goals and preferences explain why identical goods need not have identical value for different buyers.

**User-friendly description (de):** Entdecke, warum Menschen Waren und Erlebnisse unterschiedlich bewerten.

##### Konsumentscheidung bei begrenztem Budget

[consumerChoiceWithLimitedBudget.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/skills/consumerChoiceWithLimitedBudget.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare affordable bundles of goods and services according to preferences, income, and prices; apply the consumer budget constraint without treating it as the full model of all resource constraints.

**User-friendly description (de):** Wähle verfügbare Produkte, wenn Einkommen und Preise die Auswahl begrenzen.

##### Verbraucherpräferenzen

[consumerPreferences.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/skills/consumerPreferences.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how an individual ranks alternative bundles of goods and services according to their own priorities.

**User-friendly description (de):** Vergleiche, wie jemand verschiedene Güterkombinationen bewertet.

##### Grenznutzen

[marginalUtility.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/skills/marginalUtility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the change in utility from consuming an additional unit with relevant conditions held constant; distinguish it from total utility.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde den zusätzlichen Nutzen einer weiteren Einheit eines Gutes.

##### Bedürfnisse und Wünsche

[needsAndWants.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/skills/needsAndWants.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish what is necessary for a specified goal or living conditions from additional preferences without imposing a universal list of desires.

**User-friendly description (de):** Unterscheide in einer konkreten Situation Bedürfnisse von Wünschen.

##### Nutzen

[utility.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/skills/utility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret utility as a model of an individual's preferences and valuation of consumption alternatives without assuming an objective universal unit of satisfaction.

**User-friendly description (de):** Verstehe Nutzen als Ausdruck dessen, was eine Person schätzt.

### Entwicklung, Wohlergehen und Institutionen

Groups: 4 · Skills: 13

[developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Long-term differences between countries and population groups arise from productivity, distribution of resources, and rules of social interaction. Growth does not necessarily improve everyone's living conditions equally.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, warum Wohlstand, Chancen und Lebensqualität zwischen Gesellschaften variieren.

#### Ungleichheit

Skills: 4

[inequality.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/inequality/inequality.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distributions of income and wealth can differ even among societies with identical average incomes.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, warum ein Durchschnittseinkommen nicht zeigt, wie Ressourcen verteilt sind.

##### Gini-Koeffizient

[giniCoefficient.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/inequality/skills/giniCoefficient.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret a summary index of inequality and its limits in describing the shape of a distribution.

**User-friendly description (de):** Lies einen Gini-Koeffizienten, ohne ihn für die ganze Wahrheit zu halten.

##### Einkommensverteilung

[incomeDistribution.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/inequality/skills/incomeDistribution.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret income shares of population groups and changes in their relative positions.

**User-friendly description (de):** Vergleiche, wie Einkommen zwischen Gruppen verteilt sind.

##### Intergenerationale wirtschaftliche Mobilität

[intergenerationalEconomicMobility.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/inequality/skills/intergenerationalEconomicMobility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the relationship between parents' economic position and the opportunities available to the next generation.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, wie familiäre Verhältnisse spätere Chancen beeinflussen.

##### Vermögensverteilung

[wealthDistribution.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/inequality/skills/wealthDistribution.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze inequality in household net assets—property and financial claims less debt—separately from current income flows.

**User-friendly description (de):** Unterscheide Vermögensungleichheit von Einkommensungleichheit.

#### Institutionen und Entwicklung

Skills: 3

[institutionsAndDevelopment.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/institutionsAndDevelopment/institutionsAndDevelopment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Rules, trust, state capacity, and access to resources influence investment and economic opportunity.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, wie Institutionen die Wohlstandschancen einer Gesellschaft beeinflussen.

##### Zugang zu Finanz- und Grunddiensten

[accessToFinanceAndBasicServices.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/institutionsAndDevelopment/skills/accessToFinanceAndBasicServices.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the economic effects of access to infrastructure, payment systems, education, and health services.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, wie grundlegende Dienstleistungen wirtschaftliche Chancen beeinflussen.

##### Korruption und wirtschaftliche Anreize

[corruptionAndEconomicIncentives.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/institutionsAndDevelopment/skills/corruptionAndEconomicIncentives.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify how unofficial payments and selective rule enforcement influence costs and competition.

**User-friendly description (de):** Verstehe, wie Korruption Unternehmensentscheidungen und Wettbewerb verzerrt.

##### Inklusive Wirtschaftsinstitutionen

[inclusiveEconomicInstitutions.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/institutionsAndDevelopment/skills/inclusiveEconomicInstitutions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether rules permit participation in economic life and protect people from arbitrary appropriation of resources.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkenne, wie fairer Zugang und gesicherte Rechte wirtschaftliche Chancen erweitern.

#### Armut und Wohlergehen

Skills: 3

[povertyAndWellbeing.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/povertyAndWellbeing/povertyAndWellbeing.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assessing living conditions requires attention to income, opportunities, and access to essential goods.

**User-friendly description (de):** Entdecke verschiedene Möglichkeiten, Armut und Wohlergehen zu messen.

##### Absolute und relative Armut

[absoluteAndRelativePoverty.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/povertyAndWellbeing/skills/absoluteAndRelativePoverty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish resource shortfalls against a basic threshold from living below a society's typical standard.

**User-friendly description (de):** Unterscheide den Mangel an lebensnotwendigen Dingen von Armut im Vergleich zu anderen.

##### Indikatoren menschlicher Entwicklung

[humanDevelopmentIndicators.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/povertyAndWellbeing/skills/humanDevelopmentIndicators.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret composite measures of health, education, and income while recognizing their methodological limitations.

**User-friendly description (de):** Verstehe, was Indizes menschlicher Entwicklung messen und was sie auslassen.

##### Mehrdimensionale Armut

[multidimensionalPoverty.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/povertyAndWellbeing/skills/multidimensionalPoverty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate deprivations in health, education, and housing beyond monetary income alone.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, warum Armut mehr umfasst als ein niedriges Einkommen.

#### Strukturwandel

Skills: 3

[structuralChange.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/structuralChange/structuralChange.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** As productivity increases, the shares of industries and occupations and the organization of work change.

**User-friendly description (de):** Entdecke, wie sich die Zusammensetzung von Arbeitsplätzen und Branchen verändert.

##### Sektorstruktur der Wirtschaft

[sectoralEconomicStructure.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/structuralChange/skills/sectoralEconomicStructure.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish agriculture, industry, and services by their contributions to output and employment.

**User-friendly description (de):** Vergleiche die wirtschaftlichen Rollen von Landwirtschaft, Industrie und Dienstleistungen.

##### Strukturelle Transformation

[structuralTransformation.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/structuralChange/skills/structuralTransformation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze movements of labor and capital between activities and the potential costs of transition.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, was geschieht, wenn Beschäftigte und Investitionen zwischen Branchen wechseln.

##### Technologischer Aufholprozess

[technologicalCatchUp.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/structuralChange/skills/technologicalCatchUp.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess conditions for adopting technology and knowledge from elsewhere and reasons why productivity gaps close at different speeds.

**User-friendly description (de):** Verstehe, wie Länder von Technologien lernen, die anderswo entwickelt wurden.

### Digitalwirtschaft

Groups: 3 · Skills: 9

[digitalEconomy.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/digitalEconomy/digitalEconomy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Digital products and platforms change reproduction costs, market access, competition, and demand for labor. The focus is their economic mechanisms, not software implementation.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkunde, wie digitale Produkte und Plattformen Unternehmen und Märkte verändern.

#### Digitale Produkte

Skills: 3

[digitalProducts.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/digitalEconomy/digitalProducts/digitalProducts.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Information goods often involve large initial costs and low costs of reproduction, enabling different business models.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erfahre, warum digitale Produkte teuer in der Entwicklung, aber günstig zu kopieren sein können.

##### Ökonomie personenbezogener Daten

[economicsOfPersonalData.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/digitalEconomy/digitalProducts/skills/economicsOfPersonalData.data.ts)

It provides the conceptual foundation for other economic domains rather than a collection of everyday exercises.

**Methodological description (English):** Moving purchasing power into the future involves liquidity, returns, risk, and inflation.

##### Zinseszins

[compoundInterest.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/personalFinance/savingAndInvesting/skills/compoundInterest.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Calculate growth of debt or savings when accrued interest is capitalized, considering compounding frequency and duration.

**User-friendly description (de):** Entdecke, wie Zinsen auf Zinsen Ersparnisse oder Schulden wachsen lassen.

##### Notfallrücklagen

[emergencySavings.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/personalFinance/savingAndInvesting/skills/emergencySavings.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess the purpose and accessibility of funds reserved for unexpected needs without imposing a universal target on every household.

**User-friendly description (de):** Verstehe, warum verfügbare Rücklagen bei unerwarteten Ausgaben helfen.

[investmentDiversification.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/personalFinance/savingAndInvesting/skills/investmentDiversification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how allocating funds among assets affects idiosyncratic risk without guaranteeing protection from losses.

**User-friendly description (de):** Lerne, warum die Streuung von Anlagen manche Risiken senkt, Verluste aber nicht ausschließt.

##### Reale Rendite

[realReturn.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/personalFinance/savingAndInvesting/skills/realReturn.data.ts)

[simpleInterest.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/personalFinance/savingAndInvesting/skills/simpleInterest.data.ts)

[productionAndEntrepreneurship.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productionAndEntrepreneurship.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate an unmet need, potential customers, necessary resources, and risks involved in realizing a business idea.

**User-friendly description (de):** Erkenne, was eine Geschäftschance vielversprechend oder riskant macht.

[productionCostsAndScale.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productionCostsAndScale/productionCostsAndScale.data.ts)

[averageProductionCosts.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productionCostsAndScale/skills/averageProductionCosts.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (de):** Berechne die durchschnittlichen Kosten einer produzierten Einheit.

##### Ökonomischer Gewinn

[economicProfit.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productionCostsAndScale/skills/economicProfit.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate a firm's result after both explicit expenditures and implicit opportunity costs, distinguishing economic from accounting profit.

[economiesOfScale.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productionCostsAndScale/skills/economiesOfScale.data.ts)

[productionFunction.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productiveResourcesAndTechnology/skills/productionFunction.data.ts)

[productivity.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productiveResourcesAndTechnology/skills/productivity.data.ts)
